ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Thread Creation In Uncommon Target Image
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon target processes for remote thread creation Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, SourceImage, StartFunction

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\calculator\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\mspaint\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\ping\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\sethc\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\spoolsv\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\wordpad\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\write\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\csrss\.exe" OR ((SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\explorer\.exe" OR SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\OpenWith\.exe") AND TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\notepad\.exe") OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\AtBroker\.exe" AND TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\Sethc\.exe")) AND  NOT (StartFunction = "EtwpNotificationThread" OR SourceImage = RGX(".*unknown\\ process.*") OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\VMware\\VMware\ Tools\\vmtoolsd\.exe" AND StartFunction = "GetCommandLineW" AND (TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\notepad\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv\.exe")) OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Xerox\\XeroxPrintExperience\\CommonFiles\\XeroxPrintJobEventManagerService\.exe" AND StartFunction = "LoadLibraryW" AND TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv\.exe"))
